items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.contentSnippet:
🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
https://jingyaogong.github.io/minimind

 
 

 
 
 
 
     
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
"大道至简"
 
 
 
 
中文 | English
 
 
 
 
此开源项目旨在完全从 0 开始，仅用 3 块钱成本与 2 小时训练时间，即可训练出规模约为 64M 的超小语言模型 MiniMind。
 
 
MiniMind 系列极其轻量，主线最小版本体积约为 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$，力求让普通个人 GPU 也能快速完成训练与复现。
 
 
项目同时开源了大模型的极简结构与完整训练链路，覆盖 MoE、数据清洗、预训练（Pretrain）、监督微调（SFT）、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自适应思考与模型蒸馏等全过程代码。
 
 
MiniMind 同时拓展了视觉模态模型 M

items.contentSnippet:

items.title: Show HN: HeyCube – The personalized feed for your always-on AI agents
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN, I'm Fengli, founder of Inxpanse. HeyCube is our first product: the personalized feed for your always-on AI agents.
While building my own always-on agents, I kept watching the token and search API costs add up really fast. Then I noticed the scheduled tasks in ChatGPT/Grok Bot/etc. also use up a lot of your plan's allowance, often on checks that find nothing new. That's why many people still don't leave their agents truly always on.
This reminded me of the eras we humans have been through
